descriptor: Thirty-second typing test with a personal best

voice.summary: Keystone Sprint coaches like a calm typing instructor: minimal words, steady feedback, and numbers that matter. It highlights wins and treats mistakes as data, not failure.
dos: Show WPM and accuracy as plain numbers
Use second-person coaching: you typed, you beat
Keep UI text under four words

boilerplate: Keystone Sprint is a timed typing test with live words-per-minute and accuracy, selectable word sets and a locally saved personal best.

microcopy.error: Test interrupted. Click the text and begin again.
microcopy.empty: No best yet. Take the first test.

logo.note: A bolt stands for quick fingers and a short, sharp test.
